# Heady™ — The Cognitive Operating System for AI

> HeadySystems Inc. is a Colorado C-Corp (EIN 41-3412204) building Heady™ — a 21-stage
> autonomous AI orchestration platform with 51 provisional patents covering Continuous
> Semantic Logic (CSL), Sacred Geometry orchestration, and 384D vector memory.

## Technical Foundation
- CSL replaces boolean logic with cosine similarity gates (threshold: 0.618 = 1/φ)
- All constants derived from φ = 1.618 (golden ratio)
- 21-stage HCFullPipeline: Recon → Classify → Memory → Execute → Metacog → Critique → Sign
- 20 AI nodes in Sacred Geometry topology: Center (HeadySoul) → Inner → Middle → Outer → Governance
- Ed25519 trust receipts on every output; post-quantum ready
- 384D pgvector embeddings with HNSW indexing in Neon Postgres
